name: Gopuff
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Gopuff is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Gopuff is a privately held instant delivery company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $250 million round announced on November 13, 2025, was reported to value the company at $8.5 billion.

Founded in 2013 and based in Philadelphia, Gopuff runs an app through which customers order groceries, snacks, alcohol and other everyday items for rapid delivery. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company, except for the November 2025 round, which Gopuff announced without a valuation; the figure shown is as reported by Bloomberg.
round_notes: Eldridge Industries and Valor Equity Partners led the November 2025 financing, in which Gopuff's co-founders also invested. In December 2021, Reuters reported that Gopuff had raised $1.5 billion in a financing led by Guggenheim Partners, which TechCrunch described as a convertible note; it is not shown in the table.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Eldridge Industries and Valor Equity Partners led the November 2025 financing, with participation from Baillie Gifford and Gopuff's co-founders. Blackstone's Horizon platform, Guggenheim Investments, MSD Partners and Hedosophia joined as new investors in the Series H, and Accel and D1 Capital Partners led the Series F. Other investors include Fidelity, SoftBank Vision Fund 1, Luxor Capital and Reinvent Capital.
spv_sentence: SEC filings show two special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Gopuff, organized in 2021 and 2022.
sources: Sources: Gopuff's announcements of its November 2025 financing, Series H and Series F; reports by Bloomberg (November 2025), TechCrunch (December 2021 and March 2021), CNBC (March 2021) and Reuters (December 2021); and SEC Form D filings.
